correctness.rationale: The post-shift minimum eigenvalue equals the safety margin minus the one-sided Ritz error exactly. The finite-depth counterexample has a full-rank limiting Krylov basis, so continuity yields an open failure set. The signed-comparison quadratic-form inequality, weighted Gershgorin bound, monotone Collatz refinement, and sign-switchable exactness follow from classical matrix identities and were numerically reproduced.

originality.rationale: Rayleigh-Ritz, Gershgorin scaling, comparison matrices, Perron-Frobenius, Collatz-Wielandt, and Gershgorin Hessian regularization are prior art. The inspected sources did not state the PDNQP-specific fixed-margin failure criterion, the arbitrary-finite-depth open-set Lanczos obstruction, or this monotone sparse-matvec certified replacement. Originality is only to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The strong-convexity shift is an explicit hypothesis of PDNQP's inner formulation and convergence statement. The safeguard restores that condition while retaining a sparse-matvec, factorization-free computational structure and gives a monotone tradeoff between immediate Gershgorin certification and tighter comparison-matrix bounds.
